Subject: Activation stanza: POC peering & allowlist agreement

Hi Sara / CureFlow Ops team,

Thanks again for committing to the POC. Attached is a concise activation stanza (MAP fragment) that captures the environment prerequisites we agreed on during last week's call. I wanted to put the items and clear owners in writing so we can close the gate on provisioning next week. Key gating items: \n- VPC peering: CureFlow to open peering (CIDR and BGP details below). Redwood will accept peering and provision route tables.\n- IP allowlist: Add Redwood egress IPs for the staging cluster (listed in attachment).\n- Org & API keys: CureFlow needs an org placeholder we can bind to; Redwood will issue a short-lived test API key for smoke runs and a service key for the pilot.\n- Testing window: plan a 2-hour cutover smoke test on Wed 2026-06-02 (US-PST mornings recommended).\n
Please confirm the peer CIDR and preferred contact for firewall engineers. If you want, we can convert this stanza into a mutual action plan doc and add estimated completion dates per owner.

Attachments: redwood-map-poc-spec-20260527.pdf (MAP fragment, includes IP list and peering template)

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sara Patel <sara@cureflow.com>

Cc: IT Ops <ops@cureflow.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T10:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation stanza: POC peering & allowlist agreement

Mina —

Thanks for the concise list. Confirming acceptance in principle; our ops team asked for the exact CIDR pair and a config snippet for the peering so they can schedule the change. Preliminary answers: \n- We can peer from our VPC: 10.40.0.0/16 (us-west-2) to your provided peer CIDR.\n- Firewall contact: ops@cureflow.com (cc'd).\n- For IPSec/BGP: we prefer static routes and a single BGP ASN (AS64512).\n
Question: can Redwood provide an ephemeral API key scoped for 'staging:read,write' that expires in 48 hours for our initial smoke runs? Also want to confirm whether the allowlist entry needs a fully-qualified hostname or IP ranges only.\n
Appreciate the MAP doc — will review and share with our security lead.

Best,
Sara
Head of Integrations | CureFlow
sara@cureflow.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-05-27T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Activation stanza: POC peering & allowlist agreement — ops requests

Folks — forwarding CureFlow's reply. Quick asks we need to action before EOD: \n1) Ben: please pre-provision a peer CIDR on our side and prepare the peering accept config. They propose 10.40.0.0/16 -> we will use 10.50.0.0/16 as the peer on our staging cluster. Include BGP ASN AS64513 in the template.\n2) Grace: can you mint an ephemeral API key scoped to staging:read,write that expires in 48h and send as a secure note to ops@cureflow.com? Tag it with DEAL-4729 and add the API key name 'cureflow-smoke-20260527'.\n3) Jonas: please confirm whether the allowlist requires fully-qualified hostnames. If not, we'll ask them to add our egress IP ranges (see attached IP list).\n
I attached the MAP fragment and their ops csv in case you want to import the ranges. Let me know if anything blocks.

Thanks — Mina
